description: IDENTITY + DTYPE STAMP. A plain rule transforms nothing: every tensor keeps its name and its shape and the whole checkpoint carries one element type. REFERENCE-TOLERANT: a key the reference packaging itself shipped in a wider type (an F32 logit_scale on a bf16 tree, an I64 position-id table) is accepted at EITHER type, because refusing it would refuse the reference checkpoint the topology was derived from.
name: plain.bf16
